thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration): ↓ — partner business <1% y/y; expert sees ~30% growth easing to 25% in CY27.
Tenet 2 (AI second engine): ↑ — Cortex adds $500,000 to a $1 million contract; AI materiality rated 8–9/10.
Tenet 3 (governed-data control point): ↓ — BigQuery and Databricks gaining on open formats; $20 million+ contracts vulnerable to gradual reductions.
Tenet 5 (architecture shift manageable): ↓ — multi-compute model could leave 400 of 720 workloads on Snowflake.
